# Prime Logicx

> Prime Logicx is a remote-first digital solutions company offering a full range of IT services — web and app development, AI and machine learning, SaaS development, and digital marketing/SEO — delivered by one team for clients worldwide.

## Services

### Web & App Development
- Web Development — custom websites built with Next.js/React
- Mobile App Development — cross-platform iOS and Android apps
- Shopify & E-commerce Development — custom stores and theme development
- Custom Software Development — bespoke internal tools and platforms
- UI/UX Design — research-driven product and web design

### AI & Data
- AI Solutions & Automation — workflow and business process automation
- Machine Learning Solutions — predictive models and recommendation systems
- AI Chatbots & Virtual Assistants — custom-trained support and sales bots
- SaaS Product Development — end-to-end SaaS build with billing and multi-tenancy

### Digital Marketing
- SEO Services — technical, on-page, and content SEO
- PPC & Paid Advertising — Google, Meta, and LinkedIn campaign management
- Social Media Marketing — content strategy and community management
- Content Marketing — SEO-driven blog and resource content
- Branding & Identity — logo design and visual identity systems

### Cloud & Infrastructure
- Cloud Solutions — architecture, migration, and management on AWS/GCP/Azure
- DevOps Services — CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation
- API Integration Services — connecting third-party tools and systems
- Cybersecurity Services — security audits and application hardening
